title: Superior Energy Storage Performance in High-Entropy Dielectric Ceramics Discovered by AI Materials Scientist

contributions.purpose: 用 AI 自主代理导航高熵陶瓷成分空间
contributions.mechanism: AI Materials Scientist 三引擎(Knowledge/Exploration/Experiment)构成 design-manufacture-test-learn 自驱动实验室
contributions.evaluation: 提出非直觉五组分配方 0.36BaTiO3-0.32BiFeO3-0.09BNT-0.19CaZrO3-0.04SLT
contributions.domain: AI 驱动材料发现/储能介电陶瓷
contributions.source_quote: we deployed an 'AI Materials Scientist'—an autonomous research agent—to navigate the high-dimensional landscape of lead-free perovskite HECs

contributions.purpose: 实验验证 AI 设计材料的储能性能
contributions.mechanism: 固相法合成 + XRD/SEM/P-E 表征
contributions.evaluation: Wrec=10 J/cm³、η=80%、Eb≈850 kV/cm、Pmax≈33 µC/cm²(单次实验,无误差棒)
contributions.source_quote: a breakthrough recoverable energy density (Wrec) of 10 J/cm3 and a high energy efficiency (η) of 80% at a breakdown strength of ∼850 kV/cm

contributions.mechanism: 结构/微结构分析(相纯赝立方钙钛矿、致密细晶 200-500 nm、松弛体行为)
contributions.evaluation: 无二次相;细晶+高密度支撑高 Eb 与低损耗
contributions.source_quote: a phase-pure ceramic with a dense, fine-grained microstructure

self_declared_provenance.quote: we moved beyond conventional R&D models and entrusted the task of materials discovery to an 'AI Materials Scientist'
the ability of AI to overcome the limitations of conventional Edisonian research

notes: 数据红旗(重):所谓湿实验“验证”只有 Figure1-4 的定性描述,正文无任何数值数据表、无 XRD/SEM 原始数据、单次运行、无误差棒——难以判断实验是否真实开展还是图表由 AI 生成;checklist 自曝 分析[D]、写作[D] 且“all figures created by AI / all textual content generated by AI”,即科学图(XRD/SEM/P-E)系 AI 生成,数据完整性存疑。关键数字异常凑整(10 J/cm³、80%、850 kV/cm)。领域性存疑:η=80% 对当今无铅储能陶瓷仅属中等,论文却称 'superior/high',疑为过度声称。Reproducibility 声明承认代码未开源、生成非确定。trade-off:自称克服储能密度-效率两难。局限:黑箱、数据依赖、不预测合成路线。reject。
